timing_semantics: train_seconds measures synced forward/backward/optimizer including gradient clipping and pre-guard parameter snapshot; excludes project_update guards and temperature guards.
guard.measured_seconds and temperature_guard_seconds measure separate guard costs, already included in stage wall.
eval_seconds includes full repeated validation/IID/OOD/length16 evaluation, native proposal evaluation, and materialization when triggered; materialization seconds are a subset, not additive.

stage wall includes training/evaluation/guard/snapshots/periodic-checkpoint overhead, but begins after workspace witness/growth and optimizer construction; ends before final consolidated checkpoint write.

model_wall covers invocation initialization, workspace growth, stage work and checkpoint writes; native stages are separate checkpoint-resume invocations while stronger baselines execute all three in one invocation.
No standalone fixed-batch inference latency, throughput or compiled native executor benchmark recorded; eval time is not comparable inference latency.
Timing differences include warmup, compilation, code and Python overhead; no controlled repeated timing trial or equal-accuracy/fullcost frontier measured.
memory_semantics: optimizer_tensor_bytes measures tensor payloads only; representation_state_bytes sums saved reference enc/dec/transition NumPy payloads only.
GPU peak is PyTorch max_memory_allocated, not total GPU VRAM, CUDA-context memory or CPU RSS.
Parameter counts include actual total/requires-grad/row-mask active counts where reported; exact persistent model bytes not separately serialized by field.
Checkpoint storage includes optimizer/RNG/historical metadata and retained versions, not minimal deployable memory.
Replay memory payloads are extra historical learner input; common full dataset storage is experiment-harness storage and must not be confused with each learner being allowed all labels.
missing: cost of historical earlier failures/HPO as per-arm allocation
